classification: Read-only audit of observed implementation behavior; effect on task success unmeasured.
methodology: Use selected outcome_diagnostics episodes; count each adjacent invocation whose policy ID changes and whose executed_steps is positive. Exclude initial episode entry. The frozen executor sends reset=True for each such switch; the worker clears history and repeats the current observation to fill the two-frame input. Actual object/TCP backward differences are therefore unavailable to that initial chunk.
